data.raw_text:
READ: Bagong Alyansang Makabayan President Renato Reyes has been issued a subpoena in relation to cases of sedition and inciting to sedition, along with other individuals who joined the September 21 rally in Luneta.

Reyes denied the allegations in a statement released Friday, saying he was injured after the BAYAN protest in Mendiola had ended and when the commotion began, and was immediately taken to a hospital in Quezon City.

“Therefore, the claim that I ‘incited defiance and confrontation with law enforcers’ during the clashes is a total fabrication,” wrote Reyes in a Facebook post.

A subpoena dated Jan. 7 and issued by Police Lieutenant Colonel Jonathan Estrada was also received Wednesday by Jacob Baluyot, associate editor of Polytechnic University of the Philippines’s The Catalyst, prompting the respondents to appear before the court on Jan. 15 and 29 for the submission of their counter-affidavits and the start of the preliminary investigation.

Photo from Renato Reyes
